messages:
Maria C.: opened PR #4123 adding the v1->v2 deprecation note + model-swap guidance. Need quick sanity check on snippets and a short embedding-dim note.

Alex K.: quick pass: two small nits — 1) TS example still uses old `.generate(...)` shape; we should show `client.responses.create` for v2. 2) inconsistency: some pages use `model:` while others use `model_id:`. pick one for the guide.

Samir: will push a patch for the TS snippet. Question: show v1 next to v2 or hide v1 under a "Legacy (v1)" callout?

Maria C.: hide v1 under a compact legacy callout. Primary examples should be v2. Add a migration bullet: v1 embeddings = 1536d, v2 embeddings = 1024d — reindex or use alias.

Li (runtime): hosted has a temporary compat alias `embed-compat` but Dedicated/Private customers likely won't. Docs should recommend explicit `model_id` for Dedicated/Private and link to support to request alias enablement.

Alex K.: docs-bot: CI failing for a broken redirect on the old TS SDK link — needs fix.

Samir: draft TS snippet to swap in:

```ts
// v2 responses example
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rwd-chat-v2',
  input: 'Summarize the release notes',
})
console.log(res.output_text)
```

Also include a tiny mapping note: old SDK `result[0].content[0].text` -> new `res.output_text` or `res.output[0].content`.

Maria C.: add a short mapping table and checklist bullet: "verify embedding dims and update vector DB configs / reindex if needed". Also add: "If you rely on alias fallbacks, test in Dedicated/Private."

Jek: thumbs up. Also update web CDN examples that pin v1; recommend pinning only major for reproducible builds.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on PR 4123 — broken-link at /docs/migrate/v1-to-v2#examples.

Maria C.: Alex/Samir, please fix the broken link + SDK param rename. I'll merge after CI passes.

Alex K.: I'll handle the redirect and update the TS SDK anchor.

Samir: I'll push snippet patch in ~15m and ping here.

Li (runtime): added a note to Dedicated migration playbook: "contact support to request alias enablement in private clusters" — link that playbook from the guide.

Maria C.: thanks all. After merge I'll write a short release-note blurb and coordinate announcement in #announcements. Keep follow-ups here for audit.
